name: Screen Vi IQ observations with freshness and coverage filters

parameters.content:
## Vi IQ by Vultax
Set the deployed base URL in Fetch Vi IQ. Select a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_TOKEN. This workflow contains no secrets. Manual trigger only. Keep missing and stale observations visible. Methodology: https://vultax.com/methodology

parameters.jsCode: const factors = ['market_quality','liquidity_health','arbitrage_potential','order_flow','volatility','news_sentiment']; return $input.all().flatMap(item => (item.json.data || []).map(r => ({json: {...r, passes_screen: typeof r.score === 'number' && r.score >= 60 && typeof r.coverage === 'number' && r.coverage >= 0.8 && r.freshness === 'fresh' && factors.every(name => typeof r.factors?.[name]?.score === 'number' && r.factors[name].freshness === 'fresh'), screen_rule: 'score >= 60; coverage >= 0.8; all six factors present and fresh'}})));
